name: Pregnancy-Journal
summary: An offline pregnancy journal for reTerminal Sticky, with pregnancy-week tracking, weight records, and fetal movement counting.
description: Pregnancy-Journal is offline pregnancy-tracking firmware for Seeed Studio reTerminal Sticky, a compact magnetic e-paper device. Built on the Sticky Core hardware framework, it provides a pregnancy-week home screen, weight records, fetal movement counting, and settings.

compatibility.notes: For Seeed Studio reTerminal Sticky with ESP32-S3 and 32MB flash.

assets.previewAlt: Pregnancy-Journal firmware running on a Seeed Studio reTerminal Sticky e-paper device.

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: MicroSD required
notes.description: Insert a FAT32-formatted MicroSD card. exFAT is not supported. On a writable card without a dataset, choose SET UP MEMORY CARD and confirm creation. The firmware never formats the card.

notes.title: Before upgrading
notes.description: Back up the PREGJNL folder on your MicroSD card. This complete image also overwrites the internal NVS area, even without a full-chip erase. Export any legacy internal data before installation. The image does not contain or write MicroSD data.

notes.title: Installation
notes.description: Flash the complete merged image at 0x0 on reTerminal Sticky (32 MB flash). Use the erase option when replacing another firmware. After boot, check the device time, language and existing card records.

notes.title: Personal records
notes.description: This firmware organizes personal pregnancy records. It does not diagnose conditions or replace professional medical advice.
